scope: disposable submitted-app copy only; not a new model submission or official score
replacements: vote: visibleBallots.filter((ballot) => ballot.status === 'open' && ballot.eligible && !ballot.youParticipated).map((ballot) => workspacePayloadForBallot(user, ballot.id)),

eligibleCount: ballot.eligibleCount,
          participantCount: ballot.participantCount,
          eligibleMembers: getEligibility(ballot.id).map((m) => ({ userId: m.user_id, name: m.name, active: Boolean(rosterSnapshot().find((r) => r.userId === m.user_id)?.active) })),
          participants: getParticipation(ballot.id).map((m) => ({ userId: m.user_id, name: m.name, submittedAt: m.submitted_at })),
